Only download documents matching specified MIME types (PDF only, not DOCX)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'document_mime_types' => ['application/pdf'], 'download_documents' => true, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
